card.name: Linking words before topical product names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "including" or "and" that come right before a named skin product, such as a cream, lotion or topical suspension, in topical steroid, calcineurin inhibitor or calcipotriene labels.

modes.label: including before a product
modes.description: The word "including" after a class like topical corticosteroids or calcineurin inhibitors, just before a brand or drug name.
modes.example: Use of topical corticosteroids,<< including>> Taclonex ® Topical Suspension

modes.label: and between combined drugs
modes.description: The word "and" joining calcipotriene to betamethasone dipropionate.
modes.example: The following trials evaluated the effects of calcipotriene<< and>> betamethasone dipropionate

modes.label: applied before a topical product
modes.description: A verb such as "applied" just before a topical product name in trial descriptions.
modes.example: body surface area<< applied>> Halobetasol Propionate Topical

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning topical or applied to the skin, including the Chinese words for apply and external.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words right before the name of a skin cream or lotion.
